title: Late Delivery Claims Goodwill Credit: Make-Good Calculation and Goodwill Credit Caps
content:
Refund Operations calculation for the Goodwill Credit on an approved Delivery Claims Late Delivery Claim.

**Calculation.** The late-delivery make-good amount is the claim type's late-delivery goodwill amount, the figure set for the Late Delivery Claim in the Delivery Claims late delivery terms. The Goodwill Credit is the make-good amount less the delivery-charge refund entries booked on the claim, never below 0.00, rounded to the nearest cent on the final figure.

**Caps.** The Goodwill Credit is given within the Goodwill Credit caps of Gift Cards & Store Credit:

1. no more than the customer's remaining value allowance for the trailing 12 months — the Goodwill Credit annual issue cap in value less the initial value of the Goodwill Credits issued to the customer in the trailing 12 calendar months, the allowance never below 0.00;
2. nothing once the customer has received the Goodwill Credit annual issue cap in number of Goodwill Credits in that window;
3. nothing where the figure falls below the Goodwill Credit minimum issue value.

When the caps are reached nothing further is owed.

## Inputs

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| claim type's late-delivery goodwill amount | Delivery Claims late delivery terms |
| delivery-charge refund entries on the claim | the claim's compensation records: the sum of its shipping fee refund entries |
| Goodwill Credits issued in the trailing 12 calendar months, their number and initial values | the customer's Gift Cards & Store Credit instruments of the type Goodwill Credit, by issue date |
| annual issue caps in value and in number, minimum issue value | the Goodwill Credit terms of Gift Cards & Store Credit |

## Order of figuring

The make-good is figured first: any amount added to it is added before anything multiplies it, and any multiplier acts on that whole sum; where there are several multipliers, they are multiplied together and applied once to that sum. The delivery-charge refund entries booked on the claim are then taken off, with the result never below 0.00. The value allowance and the number cap apply to what remains. The minimum issue value is tested on that capped figure; a figure at or above it is rounded to the nearest cent, a figure below it gives nothing.

## Worked figures (hypothetical figures throughout)

| Make-good | Refund entries on the claim | Remaining value allowance | Goodwill Credits already received in the window, against the number cap | Minimum issue value | Goodwill Credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 25.00 | 8.00 | 40.00 | below the cap | 4.00 | 17.00 USD |
| 25.00 | 8.00 | 12.50 | below the cap | 4.00 | 12.50 USD |
| 25.00 | 8.00 | 40.00 | at the cap | 4.00 | nothing |
| 25.00 | 23.00 | 40.00 | below the cap | 4.00 | nothing — 2.00 is below the minimum |
| 25.00 | 30.00 | 40.00 | below the cap | 4.00 | nothing — the figure is 0.00 |
